body:
Real, decisive finding: pentest/scan.prn's own scan-ports references a pentest_scan_ports C function that exists nowhere real in this repo -- its own 'FFI-bound to nmap' claim was never done. Real research: FAST/SLOW/SNEAKY_SCAN map onto nmap's own official -T0..-T5 timing templates (SNEAKY_SCAN = nmap's own literal -T1 Sneaky name). 3-phase plan: Phase 0 an actually-linked pentest_scan_ports (blocking), Phase 1 real timing parameters, Phase 2 live verification. No code written -- planning only.

⚓ ☃
title: PEN-11412: scan-speed profiles scoped (Principle 19) -- found scan-ports itself was never actually implemented
